result.question: Why was Athaliah taken to the palace grounds to be killed?

readings.answer: Because she must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.
readings.support: She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD.

assessments.reason: The passage says, “For the priest had said, ‘She must not be put to death in the house of the LORD,’” immediately before they take her out and kill her at the palace grounds, so stating the reason without naming Jehoiada matches the key’s meaning.

result.reason: The text explicitly gives the reason: the priest had said she must not be executed in the LORD’s house, so they took her out to be killed elsewhere.
